summary.overview: Session Q&A across eight papers in order: first 1906.01010 (BD personal recovery; identification via self-reported diagnosis statements), then 1603.08868 (readability; POS/dependency-based linguistic features), 1905.08067 (extremist content; behavioural features like mentions, HITS), 2002.00175 (Vietnamese image captioning; NIC and Pytorch-tutorial models), 2003.11687 (concept recognition; fine-tuned BERT F1 0.89), 1805.11598 (polyglot SRL; CoNLL 2009 resources), 1806.09652 (NMT; OpenNMT Transformer), and last 1612.02695 (seq2seq decoding; label smoothing, coverage penalty). All questions were answered with cited claims; no unresolved references or new topics pending.
